title: Bound lead context: compaction ceiling, gauge, deterministic restart
body:
Lead sessions run 333-1206 turns and reset context only by auto-compaction near 967k tokens; every turn re-reads the whole context (about 500M cache-read tokens per session) and accuracy falls with length. Design and measurements: .krn/runs/claude/context-discipline/handoff.md (operator grants 2026-10-29, hook trust for this slice's scripts, thresholds 200k/120k/160k).
Acceptance:
- L1: tracked .claude/settings.json sets autoCompactWindow 200000.
- L2: UserPromptSubmit and PostToolUse hooks run a context gauge that reads the last main-chain message.usage from the transcript tail and adds a hand-off advisory once at 120k and again at 160k; state under .krn/runs/claude/context-gauge/<session_id>; any error exits 0 with empty output.
- L3: PreCompact saves a krn state check snapshot; SessionStart (startup, resume, compact) injects at most 8000 characters of restart context from files.
- L4: project env caps Bash output (12000) and MCP output (8000 tokens); a read-only haiku subagent .claude/agents/krn-reader.md returns at most 300 words with paths.
- L5: a repository rule in spec/rules.json and the krn-lead skill state the context discipline; test/rules pins settings, hooks and the agent file.
- L6: a tracked measure script reports per lead session peak context, turns, tool tokens and compactions.
- Proof: gauge tests use verbatim transcript captures (KRN-12) and fail at the base; a real lead session shows the advisory at 120k.
